snapshot.source_state: Validated replacement working tree for the Initial release root commit
snapshot.scope: Architecture reflects the intended initial state of the VISCERIUM replacement repository.

summary: Obsidian is the creator workspace. Markdown and YAML notes are authoritative. Node scripts validate and compile public Lore. Astro and Starlight build the static Codex. Generated views never replace the source notes.

source_of_truth.creator_notes: Vault/Drafts and other non-generated creator Markdown
source_of_truth.era_and_continuity_rules: Vault/System/SOPs/Era Edition Workflow SOP.md and Site/src/lib/era-context.mjs

generated_artifacts: generated continuity hubs and era tag pages

programs.name: Obsidian
programs.purpose: Edit the VISCERIUM vault and its Markdown/YAML source notes.
programs.rule: Obsidian is the editor. It is not a second lore database.

programs.name: Obsidian Bases
programs.purpose: Show filtered card and table views of note properties.
writes: note properties when a creator edits a Base cell
programs.rule: The Markdown note remains the database of record.

programs.name: Templater
programs.purpose: Run guided creation and edit workflows.
programs.rule: Use creator-facing templates. Do not run internal templates directly.

programs.name: Dataview
programs.purpose: Build live dashboard lists from vault notes.
programs.rule: Dataview reads source notes. Dashboard output is not canonical data.

programs.name: VISCERIUM Creator Tools
programs.purpose: Set controlled era values, continuity IDs, and independent era editions.
programs.rule: Use the controlled commands instead of arbitrary era text.

programs.name: StoryLine
programs.purpose: Manage private writing projects, scenes, sequence, and storyDate.
programs.rule: Do not scan StoryLine scenes as public canon.

programs.name: VISCERIUM Timelines
programs.purpose: Render canonical timelines and read-only StoryLine timelines inside Obsidian.
programs.rule: Edit the Tools source first. Treat the Vault runtime as generated.

programs.name: Chronos
programs.rule: Chronos blocks are presentation data. They do not replace canonical event chronology.

programs.name: Breadcrumbs
programs.purpose: Help local creator hierarchy and navigation.
programs.rule: The public relationship explorer does not use Breadcrumbs plugin data.

programs.name: Image Converter
programs.purpose: Convert raster artwork to the repository WebP format.
programs.rule: Store raster repository artwork as WebP. Use SVG only for genuine vector media.

programs.name: Obsidian Git
programs.purpose: Expose Git synchronization actions inside Obsidian.
programs.rule: Git remains the version-control source of truth.

programs.name: Git
programs.purpose: Track versions and synchronize repository branches.
programs.rule: Check git status before a pull when local edits exist.

programs.name: GitHub
programs.purpose: Host the repository, pull requests, and GitHub Actions.

programs.name: Node.js and npm
programs.purpose: Run validators, generators, tests, and local development commands.
programs.version_rule: Node 24 is the supported CI runtime.

programs.name: Astro
programs.purpose: Build the static public Codex from generated content and data.

programs.name: Starlight
programs.purpose: Provide the documentation-site shell, content schema, navigation, and article framework.

programs.name: Telescope
programs.purpose: Provide fuzzy public search with Fuse.js.
programs.rule: VISCERIUM scopes Telescope to the active era plus Universal. Pagefind is disabled.

programs.name: Cloudflare Pages
programs.purpose: Host the static production output from Site/dist.
programs.rule: The current Codex does not require a private application server.

zones.label: Obsidian authoring
zones.rule: Store creator facts in notes. Treat dashboards and Bases as views.

zones.label: Private StoryLine workspace
zones.rule: Keep this boundary private. Do not publish or scan it as canon.

zones.label: Canonical Lore and assets
zones.rule: Only published notes under Lore can become public Codex content.

zones.label: Content and build pipeline
zones.rule: Use Site/scripts/build-content.mjs as the main orchestration point.

zones.label: Shared era, calendar, and timeline logic
zones.rule: Reuse shared domain logic. Do not duplicate it in UI code.

zones.label: Astro and Starlight web runtime
zones.rule: Keep private secrets out of the static client.

zones.label: First-party Obsidian runtime
zones.rule: Use maintained source for compiled plugins. Keep creator-tool behaviour aligned with SOPs.

zones.label: Static deployment
zones.rule: Build from Site and deploy dist.

worldanvil_migration: Resolve existing-note and duplicate-title identity conflicts.
Resolve multi-era continuity and missing era decisions.
Resolve lawful artwork after structure is stable.
Review destination and publication status last.
story_entity_authoring: Start from Vault/Home.md or the Templater command.
Edit the Markdown note and its properties.
Run Vault Doctor after broad structural edits.
Move the note to Lore only after a deliberate publication decision.
era_edition_authoring: Set a stable entity_id on the first historical note.
Create another edition with VISCERIUM Creator Tools.
Publish under the matching Lore/Eras/<ERA> path.
Generate the all-era entity hub from shared entity_id values.
public_build: Validate published Lore and source assets.
Compile era continuity and contextual links.
Synchronise published notes to generated site content.
Generate continuity hubs and era tag pages.
Build the Astro and Starlight site.
canonical_timeline: Author calendarDate and optional calendarEndDate in canonical Lore.
Convert the source date to an absolute world-day.
Generate the super timeline and four historical era datasets.
Load one dataset in the public timeline route.
Render the static fallback and interactive timeline.
storyline_timeline: Resolve the active StoryLine project in VISCERIUM Timelines.
Convert storyDate in memory with the shared calendar model.
Open a read-only timeline that links back to scene notes.
Do not write canonical calendarDate into StoryLine scenes.
map_authoring: Author map and marker data in source notes.
Keep source map images under Vault/Assets/Maps.
Render generated data in the public Atlas.
relationship_authoring: Author meaningful relationships in note frontmatter.
Keep incidental references in prose or related.
Resolve targets with era-aware build logic.
Render global or era-scoped relationship explorers.
public_search: Let Telescope load the Starlight page catalogue.
Read the active VISCERIUM era context.
Filter Telescope to the active era plus Universal.
Collapse continuity editions to entity hubs in All Eras mode.
git_and_ci: Push a feature branch and open a pull request.
Run Vault Doctor, unit tests, benchmarks, production build, plugin build, and browser checks in GitHub Actions.
Merge only after required checks pass.

invariants: Only Vault/Lore can become public Codex content.
Do not author canonical events, maps, or relationships in generated Site/src/data files.
Obsidian Bases are views over Markdown/YAML notes.
StoryLine storyDate and canonical calendarDate serve different scopes.
calendarDate is the canonical event start date.
Public routes derive from Vault/Lore paths. Do not author slug frontmatter on published source notes.
Historical continuity editions use one scalar era and a stable entity_id.
Universal is a scope, not a fifth chronological era.
VISCERIUM never silently resolves a conceptual link into a different historical era.
Telescope is the public search provider. Pagefind is disabled.
Raster repository artwork must be WebP. Use SVG only for genuine vector media.
Tools/obsidian-viscerium-timelines is the timeline plugin implementation source.
Schema changes must stay synchronized across affected templates, Bases, validators, public schema, tests, and documentation.
The public Codex is static. Do not put private server secrets in client code.

never: re-enable Pagefind as a second search provider
duplicate calendar arithmetic in UI code
treat every wikilink as a semantic relationship
assume device-local Templater permissions are Git-controlled
commit private secrets into static client code

site.npm run doctor:vault: Check creator structure and image policy.
site.npm run dev: Build development content and start Astro.
site.npm run test:unit: Run Node unit and regression tests.
site.npm run build: Run the production content pipeline and Astro build.
site.npm test: Run Vault Doctor, unit tests, and the production build.
